meta.title: Surrogate bid: a counter offer is not allowed on it
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Responses screen.
Ensure counter-offer controls are visible for the surrogate-bid rule check.
Enable the eRFX project flow required by the prepared RFQ.
Open the event's Participants tab to add the buyer-entered bid.
Add a surrogate bid for an invited vendor using the buyer portal.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted.
Return to Responses to try the counter-offer action on the surrogate bid.

args.because: You cannot send counter offer for bids added by you.

steps.note: Assert that Counter Offer is refused for a buyer-added surrogate bid with the required message.
